init_OpenMatchTrainerProbe: initialize an OpenMatchTrainerProbe with a Detectron2 config to set BOX_AP and NUM_CLASSES
run_bbox_stat: run bbox_stat to compute multiple bounding box metrics across unlabeled ground truth and pseudo labels
compute_fp_gtoutlier: compute false positive and OOD ground-truth outlier statistics for predicted or pseudo bounding boxes
compute_num_box: compute bounding box count, average size, inlier, outlier, and confidence statistics for ROI predictions
compute_ood_acc: compute OOD detection accuracy and recall for foreground and all bounding boxes using pairwise IoU
